question: Brahm Kanchibotla, who died in April 2020 in the US, is known for his contribution in the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**journalism.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Brahm Kanchibotla** was a correspondent for United News of India.
 
• **Brahmanandam Kanchibhotla** was an Indian-American journalist known for his extensive writings on the development of the Telugu community in the USA. 
 
• During his 28-year career in the US, he had worked for 11 years as a content editor for Merger Markets, a financial publication, and also did a stint with News India-Times weekly newspaper.
 
• He died of COVID-19 in April 2020.
